title: ticks' runconfig copy needs the roles.<x>.substrates overlay or tk refuses this repo's runners.toml
body: 84z added [roles.<role>.substrates.<substrate>] to the shared half of .tick/runners.toml. ticfac's reader parses it, but ticks' copy (used by `tk herd spawn` and tk's own runs) still treats it as an unknown key and refuses the whole file, so any tk-orchestrated herd run against this repository fails until ticks' reader gains the field. The version was deliberately not bumped, per the substrate=cloud precedent — an older reader fails loudly with one line per cell.
